name: arggon
description: ArggonManager native seam: the arggon MCP tools (tracker + worktree lifecycle), /arggon commands, delivery-lead/maker/standards-reviewer agents, the goal-mode contract template (one goal per claimed item, derived from its acceptance checklist by `arggon goal <id>`), and the hook gates (global git gates; reviewer dispatch backstop). Requires the arggon CLI on PATH (npm i -g arggon-manager) — the MCP server is `arggon mcp`.
